sensor_layout_rule: eight wall-mounted sensors (user decision 2026-11-16): geometry only; each wall point moved 0.1 m into the fluid and snapped to the nearest coarse-mesh node that is not a boundary node; identical for all cases; not adjusted using true sources, signals or recovery outcomes.

proposed_inactive_sensor_layouts.wall_10: PROPOSED, NOT ACTIVE: wall_8 plus two sensors evenly spaced on the bottom aisle wall between S7 and the bathroom wall.

pde: du/dt + v.grad(u) - k Laplace(u) = S(x; z); u(0) = 0
flow_viscosity_note: the airflow's effective viscosity is navier_stokes_config.NU; it is a different parameter and is not used by the transport solve
source_formula: S(x; z) = sum_i A_i exp(-|x - c_i|^2 / rho); z = [x1, y1, A1, x2, y2, A2]
amplitude_convention: A_i = peak volumetric release rate at the centre [concentration unit / s]; the Gaussian is NOT normalized; total rate per metre depth = A_i * pi * rho
time_integrator: classical explicit RK4, lumped mass, P1 triangles (Src/Solvers/adv_diff_forward.py)

settings_rationale.diffusivity_k: k = 1.0e-2 m^2/s is the smallest of the candidates {nu_eff = 2.3244e-3, 5e-3, 1e-2} for which the cell Peclet number |v| h / (2 k) is <= 1 in every triangle of the COARSE (inversion) mesh (max 0.97), the classical condition for a non-oscillatory unstabilized Galerkin P1 discretization; the shared solver has no stabilization.  Measured with all three releases active: k = nu_eff gives cell Pe up to 4.2 on the coarse mesh (46 % of the area above 1) and a small negative undershoot (min u / max u = -6.6e-4); k = 1e-2 gives a non-negative coarse solution and the smallest coarse-vs-fine field difference (1.6-1.9 % relative L2, against 2.4-3.0 % for k = nu_eff).  k is an effective (eddy) diffusivity, a modelling parameter like nu_eff but a different one (nu_eff / k = 0.23); it is far above molecular diffusion.
settings_rationale.sigma2: sqrt(rho) = 0.20 m is a compromise fixed by the 0.95-1.0 m bed-side passages: the passage centreline is 2.4 e-folding radii from the nearest solid (Gaussian value 0.4 % there), and the radius spans 1.3 mean element edges on the coarse mesh and 2.5 on the fine mesh at the release locations (Application1's default was 2.5 on its mesh; its width study went down to about 0.9).  The 3-point quadrature of the source integral agrees between the two meshes to 3e-4 and the coarse and fine concentration fields differ by 1.6-1.9 % (settings-selection record).  A wider Gaussian would be better resolved on the coarse mesh but would overlap the bed and the partition.
settings_rationale.tfinal: T = 300 s, about one nominal air-change time A_fluid / Q_supply = 50.98 / 0.18 = 283 s.
settings_rationale.dt: largest round steps with dt * rho(M^-1 K) <= 2.5 on each mesh with its own velocity field and an integer fine/coarse ratio, so that both meshes share the observation times.
settings_rationale.amplitudes: arbitrary distinct values within +-30 % of 1, strictly inside the bounds [0.1, 2.0].
